cd /testbed && python -c "
import numpy as np
from astropy.modeling import models as m
from astropy.modeling.separable import separability_matrix
cm = m.Linear1D(10) & m.Linear1D(5)
flat = separability_matrix(m.Pix2Sky_TAN() & m.Linear1D(10) & m.Linear1D(5))
nested = separability_matrix(m.Pix2Sky_TAN() & cm)
print('flat:'); print(flat)
print('nested:'); print(nested)
assert np.array_equal(flat, nested), 'nested != flat'
print('OK: nested matches flat')
# also verify the nested-on-left variant and a 3-way nesting
n2 = separability_matrix(cm & m.Pix2Sky_TAN())
f2 = separability_matrix(m.Linear1D(10) & m.Linear1D(5) & m.Pix2Sky_TAN())
assert np.array_equal(n2, f2), 'nested-left mismatch'
print('n2:'); print(n2)
n3 = separability_matrix(m.Pix2Sky_TAN() & cm & cm)
f3 = separability_matrix(m.Pix2Sky_TAN() & m.Linear1D(10) & m.Linear1D(5) & m.Linear1D(10) & m.Linear1D(5))
assert np.array_equal(n3, f3), 'triple nesting mismatch'
print('OK: all variants consistent')
"

cd /testbed && cat >> astropy/modeling/tests/test_separable.py <<'EOF'


def test_separable_nested_compound():
    # Regression test: a compound model nested as an operand of '&' must
    # give the same separability matrix as the equivalent flat compound
    # model, whether the nested model is the left or right operand.
    nested = separability_matrix(rot & (sh1 & sh2))
    flat = separability_matrix(rot & sh1 & sh2)
    assert_allclose(nested, flat)

    nested = separability_matrix((sh1 & sh2) & rot)
    flat = separability_matrix(sh1 & sh2 & rot)
    assert_allclose(nested, flat)
EOF
